items.hook: The 1914 Rice Owls football team was an American football team that represented Rice Institute as an independent during the 1914 college football season.
items.body: In its third season under head coach Philip Arbuckle, the team compiled a 3–2–3 record and was outscored by a total of 113 to 59. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
